testCases.description: Unit tests for getUserProfile with own profile access (shows all fields)

scenarios: getUserProfile with own ID (req.user.id=1, params.id='1') returns 200 with email and phone_number included
getUserProfile with own ID returns complete user object with all profile fields (full_name, username, email, phone_number, location_*, profile_image_url)
getUserProfile with own ID and 3 sports returns user with sports array populated
getUserProfile never includes password_hash (verified repository excludes it)
Field filtering logic: req.user.id === parseInt(params.id) triggers 'own profile' path
Response status is 200 and Content-Type is application/json for successful own profile retrieval
edgeCases: Own profile with empty sports array returns user with sports=[]
Own profile with NULL phone_number returns user with phone_number=null

testCases.description: Unit tests for getUserProfile with other user's profile access (excludes email/phone)

scenarios: getUserProfile with other ID (req.user.id=1, params.id='2') returns 200 with email and phone_number EXCLUDED
getUserProfile with other ID returns partial user object (full_name, username, location_*, profile_image_url) but NOT email/phone
getUserProfile with other ID and 2 sports returns user with sports array but NO sensitive fields
Field filtering logic: req.user.id !== parseInt(params.id) triggers 'other profile' path
Other profile response explicitly excludes email field (email=undefined in response)
Other profile response explicitly excludes phone_number field (phone_number=undefined in response)
edgeCases: Other profile with skill_level='expert' in pickleball still excludes email/phone
Other profile with NULL location fields returns user without email/phone

testCases.description: Unit tests for getUserProfile with non-existent user (404 handling)

scenarios: getUserProfile with non-existent user ID (params.id='999') returns 404 Not Found
getUserProfile calls UserRepository.getUserWithSports and receives null
404 response includes error message 'User not found' in JSON body
404 response Content-Type is application/json with proper error structure
edgeCases: getUserProfile with ID=0 returns 404 (invalid ID, should fail validation or return null)
getUserProfile with negative ID (ID=-5) returns 404

testCases.description: Unit tests for field filtering logic (own vs other profile determination)

scenarios: Field filtering: req.user.id=5 and params.id='5' triggers own profile path (string-to-number comparison)
Field filtering: req.user.id=5 and params.id='10' triggers other profile path
Field filtering uses parseInt(params.id) for comparison (handles string param)
Own profile path includes: email, phone_number, plus all public fields
Other profile path excludes: email, phone_number, but includes all public fields (username, full_name, location_*, profile_image_url, sports)
edgeCases: Field filtering with req.user.id=1 and params.id='01' (leading zero) correctly identifies as own profile
Field filtering logic is case-insensitive for ID comparison (both are numbers)

testCases.description: Unit tests for getUserParamsSchema Zod validation (ID parameter)

scenarios: getUserParamsSchema validates valid positive integer ID ('123') successfully
getUserParamsSchema uses z.coerce.number() to convert string '42' to number 42
getUserParamsSchema validates ID=1 (minimum valid ID)
getUserParamsSchema rejects ID='0' (not positive)
getUserParamsSchema rejects ID='-5' (negative integer)
getUserParamsSchema rejects ID='abc' (non-numeric string)
getUserParamsSchema uses .int() to reject decimal IDs like '3.14'
edgeCases: getUserParamsSchema rejects empty string ID=''
getUserParamsSchema rejects null or undefined ID
getUserParamsSchema validates large integer ID='999999'

testCases.description: Integration tests for getUserProfile calling UserRepository.getUserWithSports

scenarios: getUserProfile calls UserRepository.getUserWithSports with integer ID parsed from params.id
getUserProfile with params.id='25' calls repository with getUserWithSports(25)
getUserProfile receives user object from repository and applies field filtering before response
getUserProfile integration: repository returns user with 3 sports, controller includes sports in response
getUserProfile integration: repository returns null, controller responds with 404
edgeCases: getUserProfile handles repository throwing error (returns 500 Internal Server Error)
getUserProfile with repository timeout gracefully handles error

testCases.description: Integration tests for field-level access control with own profile (full data access)

scenarios: Access control integration: req.user.id=10 requests params.id='10', receives email='user10@example.com' and phone_number='+1234567890'
Access control: own profile includes all sensitive fields (email, phone_number)
Access control: own profile with pickleball and paddle sports shows email + sports array
Access control: req.user object from JWT middleware is used for ownership check
Access control: own profile response includes username, full_name, email, phone_number, location_latitude, location_longitude, profile_image_url, sports
edgeCases: Access control: own profile with NULL email returns email=null (not excluded)
Access control: own profile with NULL phone_number returns phone_number=null (not excluded)

testCases.description: Integration tests for field-level access control with other user's profile (restricted access)

scenarios: Access control integration: req.user.id=1 requests params.id='2', response EXCLUDES email and phone_number
Access control: other profile response includes username, full_name, location_*, profile_image_url, sports
Access control: other profile with email='otheruser@example.com' in database returns response WITHOUT email field
Access control: other profile with phone_number='+9876543210' in database returns response WITHOUT phone_number field
Access control: other profile with 2 sports (basketball, soccer) returns sports array but NO sensitive fields
edgeCases: Access control: req.user.id=5 requests params.id='100' (non-existent other user) returns 404 without leaking existence
Access control: other profile filtering works even if email/phone are NULL in database

testCases.description: Integration tests verifying sports array is included in both own and other profiles

scenarios: Sports inclusion: own profile with pickleball (skill_level='intermediate', years_experience=2) includes sports array
Sports inclusion: other profile with paddle (skill_level='beginner') includes sports array (sports are public data)
Sports inclusion: user with 3 sports (pickleball, paddle, basketball) returns all 3 in sports array
Sports inclusion: user with 0 sports returns empty sports array []
edgeCases: Sports inclusion: sports array includes all fields (sport_name, skill_level, years_experience, preferred_position)
Sports inclusion: sport with NULL years_experience and NULL preferred_position returns sport object with nulls

testCases.description: Integration tests verifying password_hash is NEVER included in responses (security critical)

scenarios: Password exclusion: own profile response does NOT include password_hash field (verified repository excludes it)
Password exclusion: other profile response does NOT include password_hash field
Password exclusion: response object inspection shows password_hash=undefined (not present)
Password exclusion: repository layer already excludes password_hash via SELECT statement (defense in depth)
edgeCases: Password exclusion: even if repository mistakenly returns password_hash, controller should strip it (currently relies on repository)
Password exclusion: JSON.stringify(response) should not contain 'password_hash' string anywhere

testCases.description: Integration tests for soft-deleted users (status != 'active') returning 404

scenarios: Status filter: user with status='inactive' (soft-deleted) returns 404 Not Found
Status filter: user with status='suspended' returns 404 Not Found
Status filter: repository filters for status='active', controller receives null for inactive users
edgeCases: Status filter: soft-deleted user (status='inactive') requesting own profile still gets 404 (no special access)

testCases.description: Integration tests for response format (status codes, Content-Type, JSON structure)

scenarios: Response format: successful retrieval returns 200 OK status
Response format: non-existent user returns 404 Not Found status
Response format: Content-Type header is 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
Response format: success response body is valid JSON with user object
Response format: 404 error response includes {error: 'User not found'} in JSON body
edgeCases: Response format: user object includes id, username, full_name at minimum
Response format: sports array is always present (empty [] if no sports)

testCases.description: Integration tests for TypeScript type safety (AuthenticatedRequest, Response types)

scenarios: Type safety: getUserProfile accepts (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) signature
Type safety: req.user is typed as JWTPayload with id, email properties
Type safety: req.params.id is typed as string (Express param)
Type safety: repository returns User | null type (matches getUserWithSports signature)
edgeCases: Type safety: parseInt(req.params.id) converts string to number for comparison
Type safety: response user object matches User interface from auth.types.ts

testCases.description: Integration tests for error handling (repository errors, database failures)

scenarios: Error handling: repository throws database error, controller catches and returns 500 Internal Server Error
Error handling: repository timeout, controller returns 500 with error message
Error handling: malformed ID (params.id='abc') handled by validation middleware (returns 400 Bad Request)
Error handling: req.user is undefined (auth middleware failure), controller handles gracefully
edgeCases: Error handling: repository returns unexpected data structure, controller validates before response
Error handling: database connection failure, controller returns 500 without exposing internals

testCases.description: Integration tests for Zod parameter validation with controller (400 errors for invalid IDs)

scenarios: Params validation integration: invalid ID='abc' triggers Zod validation error, returns 400 Bad Request
Params validation: negative ID='-5' fails Zod positive() check, returns 400
Params validation: ID='0' fails Zod positive() check, returns 400
Params validation: decimal ID='3.14' fails Zod int() check, returns 400
Params validation: valid ID='42' passes Zod validation, proceeds to controller logic
edgeCases: Params validation: empty string ID='' fails Zod validation, returns 400
Params validation: very large ID='999999999999' passes Zod validation (positive integer)

testCases.description: Integration performance tests for controller + repository response time

scenarios: Performance: getUserProfile with own ID completes in <100ms (controller + repository)
Performance: getUserProfile with other ID and 3 sports completes in <100ms
Performance: field filtering logic adds negligible overhead (<5ms)
edgeCases: Performance: user with 5 sports still returns in <150ms (acceptable for edge case)
Performance: concurrent requests (10 simultaneous getUserProfile calls) all complete in <200ms

testCases.description: Integration tests for AuthenticatedRequest type usage (req.user from JWT middleware)

scenarios: AuthenticatedRequest: req.user contains id and email properties from JWT payload
AuthenticatedRequest: req.user.id is used for ownership comparison (req.user.id === parseInt(params.id))
AuthenticatedRequest: controller expects req.user to be populated by auth middleware (dependency on T1.3)
AuthenticatedRequest: req.user.id is integer type matching database user.id
edgeCases: AuthenticatedRequest: req.user.id type mismatch (string vs number) handled by parseInt
AuthenticatedRequest: missing req.user (auth middleware not applied) should cause error (handled by middleware in T1.3)

testCases.description: Integration security tests for SQL injection prevention (parameterized queries)

scenarios: SQL injection: params.id='1 OR 1=1' is validated by Zod and rejected (400 Bad Request)
SQL injection: params.id='1; DROP TABLE users;' fails Zod int validation, returns 400
SQL injection: repository uses parameterized queries via Knex (ID is bound parameter, not string concatenation)
edgeCases: SQL injection: params.id with special characters like quotes/semicolons fails Zod validation
SQL injection: even if Zod validation bypassed, Knex parameterization prevents SQL injection at database layer
